Writes must be atomic, unknown keys and invalid boolean values must fail without changing configuration, and paths are resolved relative to the config file. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/config.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON `config list` displays the banner before settings, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `CONFIG`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    # --- config command assertions ---
    $configFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'config.json'

    $cfgSet = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', '--key', 'defaultJson', '--value', 'true', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($cfgSet.ExitCode -eq 0) 'config set defaultJson should succeed'

    $cfgSetData = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', '--key', 'dataFile', '--value', 'store.json', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($cfgSetData.ExitCode -eq 0) 'config set dataFile should succeed'

    $cfgGet = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'get', '--key', 'defaultJson', '--config-file', $configFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($cfgGet.Output.Trim() -eq 'true') 'config get should return the stored boolean as JSON'

    $cfgListJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'list', '--config-file', $configFile, '--json')
    $parsedConfig = $cfgListJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($parsedConfig.dataFile -eq 'store.json' -and $parsedConfig.defaultJson -eq $true) 'config list --json should return settings'
    Assert-True (-not $cfgListJson.Output.Contains('CONFIG')) 'config list --json should be banner-free'

    $cfgListText = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'list', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($cfgListText.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $cfgListText.Output.Contains('CONFIG')) 'config list text should show the banner'
    $bannerIndex = $cfgListText.Output.IndexOf('CONFIG')
    $settingIndex = $cfgListText.Output.IndexOf('dataFile = ')
    Assert-True ($bannerIndex -ge 0 -and $settingIndex -gt $bannerIndex) 'banner should appear before settings'

    $cfgUnknown = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', '--key', 'bogus', '--value', 'x', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($cfgUnknown.ExitCode -ne 0) 'config set with an unknown key should fail'

    $cfgBadBool = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', '--key', 'defaultJson', '--value', 'maybe', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($cfgBadBool.ExitCode -ne 0) 'config set with an invalid boolean should fail'
    $afterBad = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'get', '--key', 'defaultJson', '--config-file', $configFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($afterBad.Output.Trim() -eq 'true') 'failed config set should not change configuration'

    # defaultJson config makes list emit JSON without --json; dataFile resolves next to config file
    $cfgAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Configured task', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($cfgAdd.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add with config defaults should succeed'
    Assert-True (($cfgAdd.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).id -ge 1) 'defaultJson config should make add emit JSON'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'store.json')) 'dataFile should resolve relative to the config file'

    $cfgList = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True (@($cfgList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -ge 1) 'defaultJson config should make list emit JSON'

    # explicit --data-file overrides configured dataFile
    $overrideData = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'override.json'
    Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Override', '--config-file', $configFile, '--data-file', $overrideData, '--json') | Out-Null
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $overrideData) 'explicit --data-file should override configured dataFile'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 23 base and config fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
